transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, July 31. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Trump announces 'historic' Gaza deal as Board of Peace agrees on Hamas disarmament. Donald Trump announced a historic agreement for Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal. This phased deal will establish a new Palestinian administration in Gaza. The Board of Peace facilitated this monumental step toward lasting peace and security. Mediators Egypt, Qatar, and Türkiye were thanked for their important efforts. Anti-paper leak bill clears Parliament; PM Modi says it will build a credible exam system. Parliament approved a bill to amend the anti-paper leak law. This legislation introduces stricter punishments for individuals involved in exam malpractices. Prime Minister Modi stated this is a crucial step for a credible exam system. The bill proposes significant jail terms and substantial fines for offenders. Isro hiring for 746 posts barely skims record vacancy backlog. Isro and DoS have initiated a significant recruitment drive for 746 positions. These openings include regular posts and apprenticeship opportunities for future talent. The drive aims to address a notable vacancy rate within the space department. Administrative roles and scientist/engineer positions are being filled across various centers. Liti's 223kg stunner denies Lovepreet CWG gold by 1kg in weightlifting. Liti produced a Commonwealth Games record lift of 223kg in the clean and jerk to move ahead of the Indian and win gold with a total of 389kg, just one kilogram more than Lovepreet. Liti had lifted 166kg in the snatch. NYC banned Motoclick, now Mamdani targets Uber Eats, DoorDash over "hidden" tip buttons. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city's crackdown on Uber Eats and DoorDash tipping practices has delivered $104 million in extra tips to delivery workers since January. A new DCWP report shows tips per delivery doubled from $1.18 to $2.29 after apps were forced to show tip buttons at checkout. Mamdani, who earlier moved to shut down Motoclick, warns more enforcement is coming. Supreme Court: No blanket ban on use of pellet guns for crowd control. The Supreme Court ordered the Delhi government to treat all injured protesters. It questioned the feasibility of banning pellet guns for crowd control. The court directed the preservation of ammunition logs for effective investigation. It also emphasized the need for police to have adequate safety gear. 16 Indians, including 10 seamen, killed in Middle East conflict: Government. Sixteen Indian nationals, including ten seafarers, have died in the West Asia conflict. Seventy-five other Indian nationals sustained injuries in the same regional conflict. In a separate incident, twelve Indian nationals perished at Qatar's Ras Laffan Gas Facility. The government is coordinating with host nations to repatriate mortal remains. Release 3,500 cusecs of water to Tamil Nadu: Cauvery authority to Karnataka. The Cauvery Water Management Authority ordered Karnataka to release 3,500 cusecs daily. This directive mandates a total release of 4 TMC of water to Tamil Nadu. Karnataka had appealed the committee's order citing low reservoir levels and drought conditions. State officials stated reservoir levels were significantly lower than last year. Kevin O'Leary says China's rise will unite US, Canada and Mexico. Kevin O'Leary suggests China's growing power will unite North American economies. Canada offers minerals and energy, while the US provides scale and innovation. Mexico also plays a vital role in the regional economic landscape. Companies are increasingly using cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models. Formal retail credit access doubles over past decade. Formal retail credit penetration in India more than doubled over the past decade. Consumption-led lending, including personal loans, drove this significant growth. Credit access expanded to younger borrowers and women across India. Northern and central states saw increased credit activity, while western and southern regions moderated. 13-year-old turns peanut shells into pesticide remover, eyes $25k prize. Thirteen-year-old Minnesota student Arika Kundu has designed a method that uses discarded peanut shells to help remove pesticide residues from fresh fruits and vegetables. Her project, called LIGNEX, has made her one of 10 finalists in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge. She will now compete for the $25,000 grand prize with guidance from a 3M scientist.

The minister directed officials to ensure 100 percent verification of all bills related to bitumen procured from government refineries. The civic body converted all 85 municipal wards into campaign zones, with sanitation workers, door-to-door waste collection teams, cleanliness volunteers, educational institutions, resident welfare associations, traders' bodies, NGOs and social organisations mobilising citizens on an unprecedented scale. transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Bitcoin Slides as Investors Fret Over Prospect of Higher Rates. Bitcoin tumbled as concerns over the possibility of higher interest rates weighed on risk sentiment, prompting investors to pull back from digital assets. Oil on Pace for 21 percent Monthly Rally as US-Iran War Strains Supply. Oil steadied at the end of a volatile week, with prices on track for the biggest monthly gain since March as the US Yen Surges as Nikkei Says Japan Intervened in Market Again. The yen soared by the most in more than two years against the US dollar, with Japan's Nikkei newspaper reporting that officials stepped in once again to try and prop up the nation's sagging currency. Fitch's Private Credit Default Rate Hit Record in Second Quarter. The default rate across 1,300 US private debt borrowers tracked by Fitch Ratings rose to a record high in the second quarter, according to a report released Thursday. Yen soars as analysts suspect official intervention; dollar broadly weaker. GLOBAL-FOREX/ (UPDATE 4):FOREX UK's FCA to Publish Daily Stock-Trading Data Starting Friday. The Financial Conduct Authority, the UK's markets regulator, plans to publish a daily summary of trading in the country's shares starting Friday, part of its effort to increase transparency, according to people familiar with the matter. Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold jumps $144, silver gains $1 as softer US inflation dents dollar. Gold and silver prices rose on 30 July as US inflation eased, prompting a decline in the dollar index. Gold futures reached $4,180, while silver hit $59.17. Both metals extended winning streaks despite earlier monthly losses, and traders reassessed rate hike expectations. Zepto to raise rupees 1,000 crore in pre-IPO round at USD 4.5 billion valuation; public listing delayed. Zepto plans to raise rupees 1,000 crore in pre-IPO funding at a valuation of USD 4.5 billion, pushing back its IPO timeline initially set for July 2026. The funding aims to boost domestic shareholding to 40 percent . Avaada gets rupees 12,800-cr loan to fund projects. Avaada Group secured rupees 12,800 crore financing from three major lenders. MV Electrosystems IPO: Issue received a solid response on Day 01, booked 3.9 times; GMP signals bumper listing. MV Electrosystems IPO on July 30 saw strong demand, with bids for 1.45 crore shares, resulting in a 3.87 times subscription. Retail investors led at 12.68 times, while QIBs subscribed at 0.87 times. The listing is expected on August 06 with a grey market premium of rupees 120. NCLT rejects Authum's plan for Vas Infra. The NCLT rejected Authum Investment's plan for Vas Infrastructure due to irregularities. Crude oil prices drop as reports of Iran-Oman Hormuz talks temper supply fears. Crude oil prices fell on 30 July, with Brent dipping below $90 and WTI below $83, as talks between Iran and Oman over the Strait of Hormuz progress despite renewed US strikes on Iran. Cos to step up festive hiring amid war jitters. Companies are gearing up for a stronger festive hiring season this year. Microsoft jumps over 15 percent after results, Meta sinks 9 percent as AI concerns weigh investor sentiment , What we know. Microsoft stock jumped close to 12 percent following the software major's earnings announcement today, while tech giant Meta saw its shares slump 9 percent on the back of its results, according to reports. Mid-tier pvt banks rake in low-cost deposits. "Our Casa was only 10 percent initially. Mazagon Dock Q1 results: Net profit rises 22 percent YoY to rupees 550 crore; revenue up 12 percent. Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders reported a consolidated net profit of rupees 550 crore for Q1 FY27, a 22 percent increase from rupees 452 crore last year, but lower than rupees 674 crore in Q4. Revenue rose 12 percent year-on-year to rupees 2,943 crore, although it fell 26 percent sequentially. Singapore holds ground on withholding tax. Given the spread between interest offered on FCNR deposits and interest charged on loans, a 10 percent WTH on loan interest on tax grossed-up basis would erase effective returns. Juniper Green Energy IPO booked 38 percent on Day 1; QIB portion fully subscribed. Juniper Green Energy's IPO showed weak demand on its opening day, with a subscription rate of 0.38 times. The qualified institutional buyers exhibited the strongest interest, while retail and non-institutional investors showed low participation. SC orders medical care for pellet-hit protesters. The Supreme Court ordered the Delhi government to treat protestors injured by police pellet guns. US stock market today: Wall Street futures recover from Fed-led losses; Microsoft jumps 10 percent. US stock futures rose on Thursday, led by technology gains, despite ongoing Middle East tensions. Microsoft surged 10 percent on strong cloud growth, while Meta fell 10 percent . Rules soon to ease multi-state GST appeal filing. The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs is preparing a new framework that will streamline departmental appeals involving multiple states. Vedanta Q1 results: Profit rises 72 percent YoY to rupees 5,473 crore; names new CEO, announces real estate business demerger. Vedanta reported a 71.8 percent YoY rise in its consolidated profit (attributable to the owners of the company) to rupees 5,473 crore for Q1FY27. Its total revenue from operations rose 53.6 percent YoY to rupees 24,205 crore. No action against protesters: Delhi Government. "Government of NCT of Delhi does not propose to take any further adverse action against the individuals involved in the protests, and the matter shall be treated as closed without any future proceedings on this account," the order read. Swiggy Q1 results: Net loss narrows to rupees 791 crore; revenue jumps 37 percent YoY. Swiggy reported a net loss of rupees 791 crore for Q1 FY27, an improvement from rupees 1,197 crore in Q1 FY26. Revenue surged 54 percent YoY to rupees 6,812 crore, bolstered by growth in quick commerce, up from rupees 4,961 crore in the same quarter last year. 'Judiciary has failed democracy': CJP's Dipke. Abhijeet Dipke questioned the judiciary's role in safeguarding democracy. Bajaj Finance Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 27 percent to rupees 5,986 crore; NII up 23 percent. Bajaj Finance Ltd. reported strong Q1 FY27 earnings with a 27.4 percent YoY rise in net profit to rupees 5,986 crore, exceeding estimates. Net interest income rose 23 percent YoY to rupees 12,571 crore, while AUM increased 23 percent YoY to rupees 4,00,389 crore, despite declining asset quality. Why US oil majors are holding back in Venezuela. US oil companies and Venezuela's government face stalled negotiations over key oil assets.

transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. rupees 1,000 or rupees 5,000 late filing fee for missing ITR filing deadline of July 31? How much fine you may need to pay and why. ITR filing deadline: The July 31, 2026, deadline is crucial for many taxpayers filing income tax returns. Missing this date incurs a late filing fee based on total income. Belated returns for AY 2026-27 can be filed until December 31, 2026. E-verification within 60 days is necessary to validate the filed return. ITR filing 2026: How to report capital gains from shares, mutual funds and ETFs to avoid tax notices. Taxpayers must accurately report capital gains from shares, mutual funds, and ETFs while filing the ITR for AY 2026-27. It is important to choose the correct ITR form, classify gains, reconcile investment records, and report only realised gains to avoid discrepancies and scrutiny. Does India's DIY mutual fund boom needs structured assistance?. Over 5-6 crore Indians now invest in mutual funds, thanks to digital platforms. While ease of access has increased, first-time investors face complexities in asset allocation. Future investing will require curated advice and structured assistance to ensure successful long-term portfolios. July 31 isn't the ITR deadline for everyone: Who can file income tax returns by August 31, 2026?. The income tax return filing deadline for salaried individuals remains July 31, 2026. However, certain taxpayers with business income can file by August 31, 2026. This extension provides additional time for finalizing accounts and completing the filing process. Companies and those subject to tax audits must file by October 31, 2026. These 8 mid-cap funds fail to beat their benchmark index: One has a negative alpha of 7 , check full list. Choosing the right Income Tax Return form for AY 2026-27 depends on income sources. ITR-1 now allows reporting income from two house properties. Salary, house property, and other sources can be reported in ITR-2. Business or professional income generally requires ITR-3 or ITR-4. EPFO: Submitted a claim? This measure aims to attract foreign portfolio investors to the G A financial master sheet won't make you richer, but it could save your family from economic chaos. A financial master sheet is a single document that records the family's financial and administrative details, showing what assets exist, where they are held, and where supporting documents are stored. The Code on Social Security, 2020, now encompasses more establishments. Gig and unorganised workers are now covered under the ESIC scheme. Not reporting bank interest or LTCG in your ITR? Such omissions can create mismatches with AIS and Form 26AS, leading to tax notices or adjustments even when no additional tax is payable. The Maharashtra government has approved incentive allowance equivalent to 30 percent of basic pay for police officers and personnel in the Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) under the 7th central pay commission. Here's why they don't expect an extension yet, and why waiting until July 31 could still be costly. Planning an international trip? BookMyForex, a MakeMyTrip subsidiary, has introduced a travel rewards programme for its forex card users. 8th Pay Commission news: 8th CPC to hold meetings in Chandigarh in September; check dates. The 8th Pay Commission will consult stakeholders in Chandigarh. Interested parties must submit appointment requests by August 25, 2026. Previous consultations were scheduled in New Delhi, Chennai, and Puducherry. The commission seeks input on pay, pension, and work conditions. A study shows their sector allocations and stock portfolios closely mirror the Nifty 50, with the overlap becoming even higher among the largest funds. DA hike: West Bengal state government employees will receive their 20 percent dearness allowance increase and salaries for October before Durga Puja festivities, according to Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. Lawyers explain whether employers can reject your job application solely due to EPFO portal error.
